policy: Post-adoption selection gate: retain only paths with a pinned Docker control, parser-derived instrumentation, and an audited AFL++ overlay. Do not backfill an excluded path with a lower-ranked lead without independent verification. The recorded adoption metrics remain positive but do not establish runnability.
